annotations.title: Get price history for an extension

description: Return how each covered registrar's renewal or registration price for one extension changed over time: price periods with the date each price was first seen, when the previous price was last seen, and whether it came from our scheduled refreshes or the registrar's own price page archived by the Internet Archive. A first record may be older than its date. Availability is not checked.

format.description: Response representation. CSV and Markdown use the same filters, order and bounded pagination; they contain main offers, not favorite comparison arrays. MCP retains structured JSON alongside rendered text.

price.description: Which price history to return: the annual renewal (default) or the first-year registration, which includes promotions.

registrar.description: Connected registrar ID from the registrars endpoint. Omit to compare all.

tld.description: One covered ASCII top-level extension, such as com or .com. Multi-part suffixes and IDNs are not covered.

name: get_price_history
title: Get price history for an extension
